title: Why Is Your Tap Dripping? Common Causes Explained
description: A continuously dripping tap is usually caused by worn internal components. In traditional compression faucets, a degraded rubber washer or pitted valve seat is the primary culprit. Modern cartridge and ceramic disc taps leak when mineral buildup damages internal O-rings or scoring prevents a flush seal. Excessively high house water pressure can also accelerate wear on these seals. Catching leaks early prevents water waste and protects your fixtures from corrosion. While replacing a washer or cartridge is often straightforward, severe internal corrosion or pitted valve bodies require professional plumbing inspection or fixture replacement.
